easyPrerequisites:
Kragma Butcher doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Aphetto Alchemist is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
description:
Activate Kragma Butcher using Aphetto Alchemist's ability by tapping it, untapping Kragma Butcher
Kragma Butcher triggers, giving it +2/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat.
